row: QA-15 - Todoist-only chrome (footer controls mirror the parse, gain Remove buttons once set)

todoist.note: Once a date is parsed, the 'Set date' button's aria-label changes to 'Remove date' (gains the Remove semantics described in the row); a submit 'Add task' button also becomes visible in this state. The Select-project/Set-priority/Add-labels buttons were not present in this same query pass - consistent with a responsive/overflow footer that collapses unaffected controls once the layout changes, though this was not independently isolated from the 'Remove' button appearing.

meologue: No footer controls exist in meologue's Quick Add at all (composer is a single title field plus an external 'Add' submit button outside the editable area) - per ledger QA-15/QA-16, this chrome is unbuilt. Not invented here.
verdict: blocked-by-design for meologue; Todoist side measured live
